description: Returns one page recipe: the ordered sections with the purpose of each, a composition file where available, and the full source of every section. Pass style to add brand tokens and adaptation instructions. Without a premium key, sections that are not free are named but their source is held back. The answer is long because it contains several complete components.

name.description: Recipe slug as listed by list_recipes, e.g. 'analytics-produkt' or 'hotel-stay'.

style.description: Style slug from list_styles (optional), to adapt the page to a brand.

name: get_recipe
title: Get page recipe
